method: Read from source, no compile and no capture (coders may not build the frontend). Artifact = design-2026-11-06/pill.html STATES[].neu + assets/pill-kit.js pill() (4 px shell padding) + assets/yappy.js worldWindow/blitWorld (buffer 176x44, open view = 0.8 x 176 art px wide). App = origin/main a1f6995 desktop/src/pill/characterFit.ts + YappyPill.tsx.

writing-polishing-pasting-done.note: plus a right segment; shell width = 204 + segment

artifact.crop: listening view rows 7.9-36.1 of the 44-row buffer; chick tufts start at row 5 (feetY 30 - 25), so the artifact cuts about 3 art px off Yappy's tufts at rest pose and more mid-hop

app_a1f6995.restCapsule: restCapsuleFor(): smallest stadium holding every pill character whole at 1 CSS px per art px, both orientations (>= 72 wide, about 55 tall)
app_a1f6995.camera: pillCamera: cell = largest whole device px per art px that fits chickBox (46 x 43 art px incl. hop 6 / squash 4 slack) in the stadium
app_a1f6995.compactStates: none: every non-resting phase opens to the same 236 x 60 capsule

gap.sprite: Yappy is drawn at 1.0 CSS px per art px in every open state on 1x and 2x; the artifact draws him at 1.39-1.56. On screen he is 64% (listening) to 72% (done) of the approved size: this is the shrunken look.
gap.shell: The open capsule (236 x 60) is already larger than the artifact shell (228 x 52); the resting capsule (about 55 tall) is taller than the artifact nub (28). The capsule is not what is small; the sprite inside it is.
gap.retina: On 2x the camera can pick cell 2 at most (stadium 110 device px after guards / 43 art px), i.e. the same 1 CSS px per art px as 1x; cell 3 (1.5 CSS px, within 4% of the artifact) needs a 69+ CSS px tall capsule for the full hop envelope.

conflict: Matching the artifact exactly (52 px shell AND 1.56 CSS px per art px) means cropping Yappy's tufts and the top of a hop, which yap-1106-fb-10 (Wilson 2026-11-06 ~17:00Z: 'it looks like the heads cropped') forbids and characterFit.test.ts pins for 17 states x 5 docks. Needs one decision: (A) artifact exact, allow tuft/hop crop and drop the fb-10 open-state pin; (B) keep whole character, grow the open capsule to about 236 x 70 so 2x draws cell 3 (1x stays 1.0); (C) keep whole character at artifact shell size by clamping the pill hop to 1 art px and squash to 0 so the envelope is about 34 art px tall (cell 3 fits a 60 px capsule on 2x).
